beginner.summary: For analysts, developers and engineers who know basic SQL and are new to BigQuery. Covers projects, datasets and locations, GoogleSQL queries, data types, aggregation and window functions, joins, nested and repeated data, dates and JSON, DDL and DML, load jobs from Cloud Storage, schemas, partitioning and clustering, on-demand pricing and cost controls, IAM, scheduled queries, Looker Studio, and a retail analytics capstone.
prerequisites: Writes basic SQL: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and JOIN
Has a Google account and a Google Cloud project with billing or access to a project owner
Uses a terminal to run commands and read output
outcomes: Query, load and model data in BigQuery with GoogleSQL and the bq CLI
Reduce scanned bytes with partitioning, clustering and dry runs
Grant least-privilege access with IAM roles on datasets
Deliver a partitioned, scheduled and governed analytics dataset with evidence of cost
